issues.t: Coolant leaking into the cylinders
issues.sym: Coolant level drops with no outside leak, a low-coolant warning, white exhaust smoke, rough running, and a check engine light with a misfire code (often cylinder 2).
issues.why: On the 2.0L EcoBoost, coolant can seep past the head gasket area into a cylinder. Ford addressed coolant intrusion in bulletins such as TSB 22-2229, and the fix is usually a new engine (long block). One owner reported the same failure on a 2.3L.
issues.next: Stop driving if the coolant warning keeps coming on or the engine misfires. Ask a Lincoln dealer for a coolant intrusion test and ask about goodwill help even if the warranty has ended.

issues.t: Battery keeps going dead
issues.sym: The SUV will not start after sitting overnight or for a few days, even with nothing left on. Owners need repeated jump starts or new batteries.
issues.why: Owners and dealers point to modules that stay awake and drain the battery, such as approach lighting or connected-car systems, plus weak batteries.
issues.next: Have a parasitic draw test done to find what stays on. Make sure any module software updates are installed, and test the battery.

issues.t: Battery monitor sensor can short and start a fire (recall)
issues.sym: Possibly no warning; in the worst case smoke or fire in the engine bay, even when parked.
issues.why: The battery monitor sensor on the negative battery cable can short and overheat.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and call 911 if there are flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. Check your VIN for recall 23V-378 and park outside, away from buildings, until it is fixed.

issues.t: Transmission jerking or failure
issues.sym: Severe jerking or harsh shifts, slipping, or warning messages, sometimes with metal shavings found in the fluid.
issues.why: The 6-speed automatic in some MKCs wears internally and owners report full transmission replacement.
issues.next: Have a transmission scan and fluid check done when shifts change. Software updates help some cases; others need a rebuild or replacement.

issues.t: Engine block heater can crack, leak and short (recalls)
issues.sym: A burning smell or tripped breaker when the block heater is plugged in, or coolant leaking near the heater.
issues.why: The block heater element can overheat or crack, leak coolant and short out, a fire risk. Several recalls cover MKC and Corsair models.
issues.next: Do not plug in the block heater until you have checked your VIN for recalls 16V-183, 25V-685 and 26V-011.

issues.t: Backup camera image distorted, flipped or blank (recalls)
issues.sym: The rear camera shows a blank, wavy, upside-down or distorted image in Reverse.
issues.why: A loose camera connector or a faulty camera can disrupt the picture.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 25V-572 and 25V-270.

issues.t: Door may not latch (recalls)
issues.sym: A door seems shut but does not latch, or will not close properly, and could open while driving.
issues.why: A part inside the door latch can break.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 16V-643 and 20V-331.

issues.t: Fuel pump may fail and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: Hard starting, sputtering or sudden stalling.
issues.why: A plating defect inside the fuel pump can make it fail.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Check your VIN for recall 15V-005.

issues.t: Fuel delivery module can crack (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell, low power or stalling.
issues.why: The fuel delivery module on top of the tank may crack, dropping fuel pressure and possibly leaking.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 14V-525.

issues.t: Start button can be bumped and shut off the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine shuts off while driving after the start button is touched by accident.
issues.why: The push-button start could be pressed too easily, cutting the engine and some safety systems.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 15V-006.

issues.t: Seat and seat belt bolts may break (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no symptoms; a loose seat in rare cases.
issues.why: Some bolts holding the seats, seatbacks or seat belts were made wrong and can fracture.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 17V-472.

issues.t: Front brake hoses may rub and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A softer brake pedal, brake fluid on a front wheel, or a brake warning light.
issues.why: Incorrect front brake hoses may rub against nearby parts and leak.
issues.next: If the brake pedal suddenly turns hard or a red brake warning comes on, press the pedal much harder than normal, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — call for a tow. Check your VIN for recall 18V-104 and have the brakes inspected if the pedal feels soft.

issues.t: Backup or 360-degree camera image fails (several recalls)
issues.sym: The rear or 360-degree camera shows a blank, distorted, flipped or frozen picture, or stays on after reversing.
issues.why: Water in connectors, faulty cameras and image processing software have all caused camera failures, leading to many recalls and repeat fixes.
issues.next: Look up your VIN for every open camera recall and have all of them done.

issues.t: Backup camera image delayed or frozen (recall)
issues.sym: The rear camera is slow to show, freezes, or shows nothing in Reverse.
issues.why: A software error in the camera system.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V-315 and get the software update.

issues.t: Hybrid engine failure can lead to fire (recalls)
issues.sym: Loud knocking or sudden loss of power, sometimes followed by smoke from under the hood.
issues.why: If the 2.5L engine in the plug-in hybrid fails, oil and fuel vapor can reach hot parts and ignite. Ford added shields, changed grille shutters and updated software, and one fix had to be redone.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and call 911 if there are flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. Check your VIN for recalls 22V-484, 23V-380 and 25V-345. If the engine knocks or loses power, pull over, turn it off and get out.

issues.t: High-voltage battery cell can short (recalls)
issues.sym: A hybrid system warning, reduced charge or electric range, loss of drive power, or in rare cases a fire.
issues.why: Defects in the high-voltage battery cells or welds can cause shorts or sudden battery failure. Some remedies limit charging until the battery is checked or replaced.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 22V-149, 22V-331, 24V-954 and 26V-091 and follow any charging limits in the letter.

issues.t: Vehicle may shift into Neutral on its own (recall)
issues.sym: A sudden loss of drive power as the plug-in hybrid drops into Neutral.
issues.why: Control module software can command Neutral unexpectedly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 24V-330 and 25V-133 and get the software update.

issues.t: Windshield wiper motor can fail (recall)
issues.sym: Wipers stop working or move slowly.
issues.why: The front wiper motor can fail.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-117.

issues.t: Loose transmission bolts may leak fluid (recall)
issues.sym: Red fluid under the car, harsh shifts or loss of drive.
issues.why: Bolts on the start-stop accumulator can be loose or missing.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 20V-550.

issues.t: Rear coil spring can break (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk or bang from the rear, or the SUV sitting lower on one corner.
issues.why: A rear coil spring can rub on the toe link bracket and break.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 20V-470.

issues.t: AWD rear drive unit low on oil can seize (recall)
issues.sym: A whine or grind from the rear, then possible axle lock-up.
issues.why: Some rear drive units were built without enough oil.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 21V-011.

issues.t: Fuel delivery module may leak and stall (recall)
issues.sym: Fuel smell, hesitation or stalling.
issues.why: The fuel delivery module can leak and lower fuel pressure.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Check your VIN for recall 21V-625.

issues.t: Seat belt reminder chime too short (recall)
issues.sym: The unbuckled seat belt chime sounds only briefly.
issues.why: Audio module software makes the chime shorter than federal rules require; the first fix was not right.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 22V-953 and 25V-338.

issues.t: Fuel injector O-ring support missing (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell from the engine bay.
issues.why: Fuel injectors may be missing O-ring support discs, which can let fuel leak.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V-634 and do not ignore a fuel smell.

issues.t: Rear lights can fill with water and fail (recall)
issues.sym: Moisture inside the tail lights and brake or turn lights not working.
issues.why: Water can get into the rear combination lamps.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V-688.

issues.t: Rear seat belt retractors may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no symptoms.
issues.why: Rear seat belt retractors may not be bolted down securely.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V-862.

issues.t: Windshield may have air bubbles (recall)
issues.sym: Bubbles in the glass that distort the view.
issues.why: Some windshields were made with air bubbles.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V-730.

issues.t: EGR valve can fail and cut engine power (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden loss of power or a reduced-power mode with a check engine light.
issues.why: The exhaust gas recirculation valve can fail.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-122.

issues.t: Instrument cluster may stay dark (recall)
issues.sym: The gauge cluster does not light up.
issues.why: A faulty instrument cluster.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V-049.

issues.t: Cylinder head plugs can leak oil (recall)
issues.sym: Oil leaks, burning oil smell, or low oil warnings.
issues.why: A cylinder head defect can let small sealing plugs fail and leak oil.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V-828 and watch the oil level.

issues.t: Park may not engage (recall)
issues.sym: The SUV can roll after shifting to Park.
issues.why: The park module may fail to lock the transmission.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-301 and always set the parking brake.
